summary: Verified bugfix that get_teachers and get_teacher merge branches from both teacher_branches and teacher_prices tables. Created pytest suite (7 passed, 3 skipped) and UI-tested login+/teacher/content for İlknur (Türkçe), Buse (Fen Bilimleri), and Sıla (Matematik). All 3 teachers see ONLY their branch's expected book with no cross-branch leakage.

minor.issue: Teacher-side filter still only reads teacher_branches (line 5814), not teacher_prices. Works today because either teacher_branches is populated OR the endpoint returns all books when empty and the client filters by merged branches — but merging teacher_prices here would be more consistent with the get_teachers fix.

GET /homework/books still filters using teacher_branches only. Not currently causing UI issues due to client-side merging but should be aligned.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The bugfix on get_teachers/get_teacher (server.py lines 1251-1317) is verified end-to-end. Books shown per teacher: İlknur→'Yeni kitap Türkçe', Buse→'Yeni kitap Fen denemesi', Sıla→'Yeni kitap Matematik', no cross-branch bleed. Consider extending the same merge (teacher_branches ∪ teacher_prices) inside GET /homework/books teacher branch filter for symmetry.
rca of the issue: UI writes branch assignments to teacher_prices table while legacy code path expected teacher_branches. Fix takes union of both when returning teacher.branches so downstream UI (which uses teacherData.branches to filter books) sees consistent data regardless of write path.
